## Discovery & Translational Science

* **IRF1-driven retroelement feed-forward loop identified in cutaneous lupus** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26359525)
  * Multi-omic profiling of 57 cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE) skin biopsies revealed 131 interferon-responsive retroelement families (termed FIRE), with IRF1 binding motifs present at 28.78% of 2,108,727 identified loci.
  * Stimulation-dependent chromatin opening at FIRE loci was abolished in IRF1-knockout models, leading to accumulation of immunogenic double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) substrates.
  * Type I interferon receptor blockade via anifrolumab suppressed FIRE transcription in CLE tissue, whereas JAK inhibition did not.

* **Spatial single-cell imaging maps immune injury niche in checkpoint inhibitor hepatotoxicity** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26360744)
  * Imaging mass cytometry of liver biopsies from patients with immune-mediated liver injury from checkpoint inhibitors (ILICI) identified histiocyte-rich granulomas composed of co-localized CD8⁺ T cells and activated memory-effector macrophages.
  * Spatial analysis confirmed direct CD8⁺ T cell–macrophage coupling associated with localized cell death via cleaved caspase-3 (apoptosis) and cleaved gasdermin D (pyroptosis).

* **Systematic evaluation assesses epigenetic clocks as surrogate aging biomarkers** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04562-9)
  * A broad analysis evaluated 16 DNA methylation aging clocks across 51 longitudinal human intervention studies to determine their responsiveness to pharmacological and lifestyle longevity interventions.
  * Accompanying analysis assessed whether epigenetic clocks meet formal criteria for surrogate endpoints by responding consistently during genuine clinical benefit.

* **Human hippocampal atlas identifies neurogenesis dysregulation in depression** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04571-8)
  * A multiomic single-cell atlas of the adult human hippocampus in major depressive disorder (MDD) mapped disruptions in adult neurogenesis, local transcriptional networks, and neural circuitry.
  * The dataset highlights stress- and cellular aging-related molecular pathways regulating neuroplasticity in the adult dentate gyrus.

* **CSF 5-HIAA tracks primary and secondary injury in traumatic spinal cord injury** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26360513)
  * Prospective tracking of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) collected every 8 hours in acute cervical or thoracic spinal cord injury patients identified significant elevations in 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid (5-HIAA).
  * Serial changes in CSF 5-HIAA correlated with acute clinical exam shifts and long-term motor recovery outcome scores.

* **Long-read RNA sequencing enhances splicing outlier detection in rare disease** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26360476)
  * Long-read RNA sequencing (lrRNA-seq) of whole blood from 20 rare disease trios yielded uniform transcript coverage, identifying a mean of 24,439 isoforms per sample.
  * Unannotated transcript isoforms comprised 18.5% of total discoveries, with 74.3% of unannotated isoforms localized within known disease-associated genes.

* **Preclinical insights in oncology and neurobiology** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628855/)
  * A systematic meta-analysis confirmed consistent preclinical in vivo and in vitro antitumor activity for scorpion venom-derived peptides across multiple tumor models. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628855/)
  * Caffeic acid phenethyl ester derivatives demonstrated cytotoxic activity against cancer cell lines mediated by glyoxalase I inhibition. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628765/)
  * Local field potential recordings in Parkinson's disease patients showed that structured musical stimulation selectively suppresses 13–30 Hz beta synchrony while elevating theta activity in the dorsal sensorimotor subthalamic nucleus. [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.17.26360495)

---

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **Mazdutide demonstrates weight loss efficacy in US Phase II trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628555/)
  * A US-based, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial evaluated the efficacy and safety of the dual GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist mazdutide in adults with obesity or overweight.

* **Memantine improves cognitive outcomes in Phase II systemic lupus erythematosus trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42629232/)
  * A Phase 2 randomized, placebo-controlled study demonstrated statistically significant improvements in neuropsychological function among systemic lupus erythematosus patients treated with memantine versus placebo.

* **Phase I/II trial tests lithium mouthwash for radiation-induced oral mucositis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628808/)
  * A Phase I/II clinical trial evaluated a lithium-containing mouthwash formulation aimed at reducing oral mucositis and associated taste dysfunction in patients receiving head and neck radiotherapy.

* **Tofacitinib evaluated against steroid mini-pulse in active vitiligo** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628800/)
  * A 24-week randomized, assessor-blinded trial evaluated oral tofacitinib against oral corticosteroid mini-pulse therapy for arresting active vitiligo, tracking serum IL-6 levels as a surrogate inflammatory marker.

* **Feasibility trial evaluates psilocybin-assisted therapy in NHS setting** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04597-y)
  * A clinical feasibility study delivering psilocybin-assisted therapy to patients with treatment-resistant depression within the UK National Health Service reported acceptable adherence and safety parameters.

---

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Roche reports Phase III SKYSCRAPER-07 results in esophageal cancer** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42628839/)
  * The randomized Phase III SKYSCRAPER-07 trial evaluated atezolizumab (Tecentriq) with or without the anti-TIGIT antibody tiragolumab in patients with unresectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma following definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Real-world trial compares mavacamten to alcohol septal ablation in oHCM** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26360764)
  * A propensity-matched study of 220 patients with obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy evaluated Bristol Myers Squibb's cardiac myosin inhibitor mavacamten against alcohol septal ablation over 12 months.
  * Both therapeutic strategies yielded marked functional capacity improvements and left ventricular outflow tract gradient reductions.

---

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **Ocular Therapeutix targets Q4 NDA submission for Axpaxli in wet AMD** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2090756564000891177)
  * Ocular Therapeutix confirms alignment with the FDA on an approval pathway for Axpaxli in wet age-related macular degeneration based on data from the single pivotal SOL-1 study.
  * The company remains on track for a Q4 NDA filing, with international regulatory submissions planned for 2028 following the SOL-R trial.

* **FDA schedules public hearing on therapeutic regulations for psychedelics** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/fda-meetings-conferences-and-workshops/considerations-potential-future-therapeutic-use-psychedelic-drugs-public-hearing-09142026)
  * The FDA announced a public hearing for September 14, 2026, to gather stakeholder input on regulatory framework design and trial controls for psychedelic drug products administered in supervised settings.

* **FDA releases 55 draft product-specific guidances for generic drug development** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-publishes-new-product-specific-guidances-facilitate-generic-drug-development)
  * The FDA published 55 draft product-specific guidances (PSGs) to assist Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) filings.
  * The release includes 18 PSGs for complex products and over 30 guidance documents for reference drugs currently lacking approved generic options.

---

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Werewolf Therapeutics to merge with Ambros Therapeutics in $500M deal** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2090771268412817676)
  * Werewolf Therapeutics (HOWL) signed an all-stock merger agreement with Ambros Therapeutics, valuing Ambros at $500M and Werewolf at $47.5M.
  * The transaction is backed by a concurrent oversubscribed $150M private placement; legacy Werewolf shareholders will hold approximately 6.8% of the combined company.

* **[Biotech]** **Activist investor demands governance overhaul at Capricor Therapeutics** [BioPharm Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/capricor-kaos-bristol-myers-chai-lilly-amplitude-kynexis/828284/)
  * Kaos Capital issued an open letter calling for a board overhaul and strategic review committee at Capricor Therapeutics one day prior to an FDA decision deadline for its Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy.
  * Kaos urged Capricor to freeze non-essential capital spending and diversify its pipeline beyond a single-asset model.

* **[Biotech]** **Gossamer Bio raises up to $250M private placement for seralutinib** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2090771513892884734)
  * Gossamer Bio (GOSS) executed a structured private placement for up to $250M, including $150M in committed capital.
  * The financing includes $25M at initial closing and $125M contingent upon FDA acceptance of the seralutinib NDA in pulmonary arterial hypertension.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Genentech commits $750M to expand Oregon manufacturing facility** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/21/roche-genentech-investment-estrogen-patch-shortages/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Roche subsidiary Genentech will invest $750M to double the footprint and production capacity of its commercial manufacturing site in Oregon.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk report quarterly oral GLP-1 revenue dynamics** [BioPharm Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/glp-1-market-cost-prescribing-preferences/828424/)
  * Eli Lilly reported total Q2 revenue near $23B, driven by tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound), though its oral candidate Foundayo generated $98M, missing consensus projections.
  * Novo Nordisk reported $354M in first-quarter sales for its oral Wegovy formulation as both companies step up enforcement against unapproved compounded alternatives.

---

## Public Health & Policy

* **HHS document signals potential revisions to federal vaccine recommendations** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/21/rfi-reveals-possible-kennedy-strategy-vaccine-policy-changes/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * An HHS Request for Information (RFI) outlines potential restructuring of federal vaccine recommendation categories and modifications to baseline pre-market safety testing requirements.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Merck Ebola vaccine deployed to manage DRC outbreak** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/21/health-news-scientists-deploy-merck-ebola-vaccine-in-drc/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Health agencies initiated targeted vaccination campaigns in the Democratic Republic of the Congo utilizing Merck’s Ervebo vaccine to stop active Ebola virus transmission.

        - Dr. Thomas Kelly outlines the safety risks associated with using AI scribes for clinical documentation.

        - It explains why physicians may fail to notice critical, dangerous errors introduced into clinical notes.

    - [Sperm’s Secret Messages: Beyond DNA](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6L__oKL8Q8w) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Research indicates that paternal lifestyle factors—including diet, stress, and nicotine use—can be inherited by offspring via sperm.
        - A study published in *Cell Metabolism* demonstrates that paternal exercise confers endurance capacity to offspring through sperm microRNAs.
        - The transmitted sperm microRNAs directly influence gene expression inside the developing embryo.
